paragraphs: Rabbi Avin bar Rav Adda said in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name: Pesachim 8b; Berakhot 6a; Eruvin 8a, 11a, 99b; Bava Kamma 116b; Niddah 66b; see above. Shabbat 130, end of a: Abba bar Adda said in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name—certainly an error; it should be Avin bar Adda. Rif reads “Rabbi Avin said in Rabbi Adda’s name in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name”—also an error. Pesachim 34, beginning of a: Ravin bar Rav Acha said in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name—undoubtedly an error; it should be bar Rav Adda. Rav Menachem of Kefar She'arim said, Niddah 27a—meaning Rabbi Menachem was in his time; it was copied here without purpose.

Yuchasin, letter resh, writes: “Ravin bar Adda and his brother Rava” (it should read Rabbah), “students of Rav Yehudah,” because they spoke in his name; Beitzah, chapter Hamevi; Ketubbot 7b: Ravin bar Rav Adda and Rabbah bar Rav Adda, both in Rav Yehudah’s name. Yoma 53b: both speak in Rav’s name; Kiddushin 70b: “Rav said.” Ravin bar Rav Adda told Rava, “Your students say”; Rav Amram said (see there).
